{{Quote|The Chief Security Officer of Stonewall Labs before the shutdown was a man named Vance Groten. I think he'll have an idea of where to find a beacon.|Professor [[Zanier Hudmasse]], to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GtVG" />}}
'''Vance Groten''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived in [[Dee'ja Peak/Legends|Dee'ja Peak]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|Dee'ja Peak is probably the most beautiful mountain town on Naboo. I'm lucky to work here.|Vance Groten, to a spacer|<ref name="SWG:GtVG" />}}
By the time of the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], Vance Groten was the [[Chief of Security/Legends|Chief Security Officer]] at [[Stonewall Labs]] before the company closed.<ref name="SWG:ORDMTD">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Old Republic Droid Modules: The Droideka|Naboo}}</ref> His [[Security officer/Legends|security officers]] included [[Kippy Martin]] and [[Walker Luskeske]].<ref name="SWG:FaSB">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Find a Security Beacon" on Naboo</ref> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> he met a spacer who was trying to acquire an [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] droid module from Stonewall Labs. Vance Groten offered to help the spacer find a [[security beacon]] from Stonewall Labs. In exchange, Groten asked the spacer to eliminate groups of [[Maulers]] and [[Naboo pirates]], as well as [[Blot]]'s pack of aggressive feral [[shaupaut]]s, that threatened Dee'ja Peak.<ref name="SWG:HKDPS">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Help Keep Dee'Ja Peak Safe|Naboo}}</ref> Groten later fixed a Stonewall Labs security beacon acquired by the spacer from Walker Luskeske.<ref name="SWG:FaSB" /> As a favor, Vance Groten also asked the spacer to recover a ring that was a family heirloom lost during a [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] game with [[Herman Pate]]. However, Pate had lost the ring to [[Janelle]], a [[Mountaintop smugglers|smuggler]] leader. The spacer was thus forced to fight the smugglers to recover the ring.<ref name="SWG:DVGaF">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=other}}Legacy Quest: "Do Vance Groten a Favor" on Naboo</ref> However, the security beacon was stolen in the meantime by [[Strehkforce]] mercenaries. The spacer then attacked [[Strehkforce Camp|their camp]] and killed their leaders [[Evan Strehk]] and [[Maris Fahrs]] to recover the security beacon.<ref name="SWG:GtSBBftM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|Get the Security Beacon Back from the Mercenaries|Naboo}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Vance Groten appeared as a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:GtVG" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> Vance Groten was added to the game as part of the "[[W:c:swg:Legacy Quest|Legacy Quest]]" with the release of the "[[W:c:swg:Publish 25 Notes for November 15, 2005|Publish 25]]", a.k.a. the "[[W:c:swg:New Game Enhancements|New Game Enhancements]]," on [[November 15]], [[2005]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Archive 2005">{{SonyCite|url=players/content.vm?id=64886&resource=publish|text=Publish Archive 2005}}</ref>
